culturalPrinciplesSection.title: Values and Priorities of Cultural Work in Syria

1.title: Enhancing National Pride
1.description: We work to cultivate a sense of national pride among Syrians and strengthen their connection to their ancient and ever-evolving cultural heritage.

2.title: Elevating Syria's International Image
2.description: We strive to highlight Syria's global standing by enhancing its cultural and diplomatic presence and reaffirming its continuous humanitarian and civilizational role.

3.title: Establishing a Human-Centric Approach
3.description: We place the human being at the heart of cultural work to ensure dignity and well-being, providing an environment that gives every individual the recognition they deserve.

4.title: Reviving Cultural and Historical Identity
4.description: We celebrate Syria's ancient heritage and preserve its historical components so they remain an integral part of a sustainable, daily national identity.

5.title: Encouraging the Return of Syrians
5.description: We create a supportive cultural and social environment that encourages Syrians from around the world to return and participate in building a prosperous future for their homeland.

6.title: Transforming Syria into a Global Cultural Destination
6.description: We seek to establish Syria as a significant cultural destination visited by the world to discover its history, arts, and unique human experiences.

7.title: Promoting Opportunities for Growth and Prosperity
7.description: We highlight Syria's growing cultural and economic potential to enhance opportunities for investment, production, and creativity, supporting national societal prosperity.

theUnesco.title: Syrian Heritage on the UNESCO List
theUnesco.description:
From Aleppo's Qudud to the Damascene Rose, and from hand-blown glass to laurel soap, everything in Syria tells the story of a people who shaped their civilization with love and mastery.

The Ministry of Culture continues to preserve this living legacy, ensuring that Syria's heritage remains a testament to a spirit that knows how to create eternal beauty through the passage of time.

eagleHeritage.title: The Eagle in Syrian Cultural Memory
eagleHeritage.subtitle: Symbol of Strength and Balance
eagleHeritage.caption: A symbol of the ability to protect the land and preserve society
eagleHeritage.introduction: The eagle occupies a place in Syrian cultural memory as a symbol of strength, balance, and the ability to protect the land. It was known in ancient Eastern civilizations as a bird embodying prestige and sublimity, and has been used throughout the ages as a sign of stability and a state capable of preserving its society and defending its borders.
eagleHeritage.footnote: It is considered one of the oldest models of symbolic expression in the Near East

neolithic.title: Tell al-Jarf al-Ahmar
neolithic.description: The oldest archaeological evidence of the eagle symbol in Syria, a basalt piece representing a bird of prey from the eagle family

ancient.title: Prestige and Sublimity
ancient.description: The eagle was known as a bird embodying prestige and sublimity, used throughout the ages as a sign of stability and capable statehood

islamic.title: Strength and Wisdom
islamic.description: The eagle was associated with major historical milestones and symbolic significance, representing strength and wisdom in public affairs management

modern.title: National Identity
modern.description: The golden eagle became a visual emblem of national identity, combining civilizational heritage with the expression of sovereignty

eagleHeritage.closingStatement: Today, in post-liberation Syria, the eagle symbol emerges within a national narrative that affirms culture's role in consolidating identity and building society
eagleHeritage.motto: Towards an inclusive culture… that narrates memory and builds humanity

visionSection.quote: “Vision is neither a slogan nor a <secondary>decision.</secondary>. Today, it stands as the title of recovery, <primary>the restoration of the civilizational narrative, and the building of the future.”</primary>

hero.title: Our Vision:
hero.description: To consolidate Syria's position as the heart of the world and to shape a prosperous and renewed future

whoWeAre.title: Who We Are
whoWeAre.subtitle: Ministry of Culture
whoWeAre.establishment: The Ministry of Culture was established in the Syrian Arab Republic on November 23, 1958, as the national body responsible for formulating cultural policies, preserving tangible and intangible cultural heritage, supporting arts and creativity, and expanding community participation in cultural life, in a way that preserves the Syrian civilizational identity and enhances its presence regionally and internationally.
whoWeAre.postLiberation: In the post-liberation phase, the Ministry is working to rebuild its role after decades during which the cultural space was restricted and knowledge and creative institutions were marginalized, which weakened the ability of culture to perform its societal function. Based on this, the Ministry today seeks to consolidate cultural work as a space for free dialogue and responsible creativity, and a fundamental pillar in building a just, supportive, and diverse society.
whoWeAre.futureDirection: In this context, the Ministry is moving towards developing a national cultural system based on knowledge, cultural justice, community participation, and empowering cultural actors in various governorates, in a way that restores culture's role as a driving force for development and stability, and a foundation for building an inclusive national identity in the transitional phase and beyond.

vision.title: Vision
vision.description: Building a cultural sector that reflects the depth of Syria's civilization, responds to the needs of society, and makes culture a unifying force that strengthens national identity, connects the past with the present, the inside with the outside, and elevates the aspirations of Syrians towards a more stable and prosperous future.

mission.title: Mission
mission.description: The Ministry of Culture is committed to developing cultural policies and programs that ensure the right of all citizens to access and participate in culture, protect tangible and intangible cultural heritage and reintegrate it into public life, support arts, creative industries, and crafts as economic and developmental tributaries, enhance Syrian cultural presence regionally and internationally, and empower children, youth, women, and local communities to contribute to building a national cultural scene that reflects the Syrian society's energies and civilizational history.

ministerWord.title: Word from the Minister of Culture
ministerWord.subtitle: Minister's Message
ministerWord.paragraph1: For thousands of years, Syria has been a cradle of civilizations, a starting point for the alphabet, a meeting place for religions, and a stage for thought, poetry, and art. Today, as we face major challenges, we believe that culture is not a luxury, but a national necessity, and an integral part of our project to repair the soul, build the human being, and restore the civilizational narrative.
ministerWord.paragraph2: At the Ministry of Culture, we work with an open mind and a heart that understands the pulse of the Syrian street. We seek to empower creativity, embrace youth, preserve heritage, and enhance dialogue among all components of society, both inside Syria and in the diaspora.
ministerWord.paragraph3: I invite you to be partners in shaping Syria's cultural future, each from their own position, for culture is not monopolized by institutions, but is the pulse of daily life, in the home, in the street, in the school, in kind words, refined behavior, and noble stances.
ministerWord.closingQuote: Together we write a new chapter in Syria's memory, titled: Dignity, Awareness, and Beauty.

nationalCulturalIdentity.title: Ministry of Culture… the identity that unites Syrians

ourMessageSection.title: Our Message
ourMessageSection.description: Syria should lead the transformation with a future vision that empowers its people while preserving the authenticity of its heritage.

syrianStorySection.title: Our story <secondary>is not a story of destruction,</secondary> but <primary>determination</primary> told by generation after generation…
syrianStorySection.description: The Syrian story is a story that stirs emotions, where pain and hope intertwine. It is a story of struggle between good and evil, between the weak right, which has no supporter but God, and the powerful wrong, which possesses all the tools of killing and destruction. For our story is a lesson from history, a true representation of the noble meanings of humanity.
syrianStorySection.quote: We in the Ministry of Culture strive to tell the Syrian story in a manner befitting its importance…

3.description: A delegation from the Ministry of Culture visited the Qatar National Library to explore its most prominent departments and cultural initiatives.
